description: Tier 1 automated test plan, no pauses. EnableImmerse + ConvolutionType assertions are real state transitions (each preceded by a setup that forces the opposite value, so Wwise does push). HeadphoneEq remains in discovery mode until we observe the plug-in's runtime log signature for HPEQ changes (the value setProperty works -- visually verified -- but the log line emitted on change is not yet encoded as an assertion regex). Property values come from the Immerse plug-in XML: ConvolutionType {0=Universal, 1=Personalized}; HeadphoneEq enum: 0=NONE, 102=Universal Closed Back, 104=Universal Open Back, 26=Cloud Alpha, 16=Arctis Nova Pro Wireless, 38=G535, 23=Black Shark V2 Pro Wireless, 21=A50, 80=MMX 300, 66=HS80 RGB Wireless.
